items.a: Any SCU undergraduate, graduate student, faculty or staff member.

items.q: Do I need to be a bio or pharma major?
items.a: No. CLIP is for every major, from bioengineering and chemistry to computer science and business.

items.q: What makes someone an active member?
items.a: Coming to at least two CLIP events a quarter. Meetings, seminars and off-campus visits all count.
General meetings are weekly: [day, time, room].

items.q: How do I join the board?
items.a: Officers are picked by application each spring, in week 4 of spring quarter.

items.q: Can I suggest a speaker or event?
items.a: Yes. Email connectingleaders@scu.edu or tell a board member at a meeting.
